description: Reinsurer strength from SEC filings, for placing reinsurance: capital and growth, premiums and reserves to capital, five years of reserve development (Schedule VI: strengthened or released, % of opening reserves), accident-year loss ratio, return on capital, debt, investments to net reserves, warning filings, and a boat (count of six published warning signs). Property & casualty reinsurers plus RGA (life). A description from filings, not a rating; ratings and regulatory capital are not SEC data.
name: get_reinsurer_strength
